## What this changes

One paragraph: what the change does, why, and what it deliberately leaves out.

## Rule ids touched

The ids in `rules/registry.json` this change adds, edits or newly enforces, or "none".

## Checks

- [ ] `just check` exits 0 (ruff, tests on 3.9 and 3.14, validate, check-skills, lint-voice, coverage, plugin validate)
- [ ] A rule with a mechanism has a test in `tests/`
- [ ] `docs/coverage.md` regenerated if the registry changed
- [ ] Every commit is signed off in a person's name; no tool trailer, no generated-with footer (ATTR-1)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for a user-visible change
